w6g.ev.twn_crossroads.title: Crossroads in the Taiwan Strait
w6g.ev.twn_crossroads.desc: Changing leadership currents and shifting Pacific alignments force Taipei to decide whether to harden maritime deterrence, cultivate quiet coexistence across the Strait, or extend underground mainland networks.
w6g.ev.twn_crossroads.con1: Naval readiness rises alongside Pacific partner confidence, at steady fiscal cost.
w6g.ev.twn_crossroads.con2: Domestic calm and shipping access improve while offensive war fervor cools.
w6g.ev.twn_crossroads.con3: Covert networks and expeditionary readiness deepen at the price of international scrutiny.
w6g.ev.chn_strait.title: Strait Posture Review in Beijing
w6g.ev.chn_strait.desc: Advisors clash over the Taiwan Strait: naval commanders urge intensified encirclement patrols, trade ministries favor maritime calm, and party inspectors warn of coastal strain.
w6g.ev.chn_strait.con1: Naval drills and border reserves expand across the Strait.
w6g.ev.chn_strait.con2: Shipping confidence and domestic stability strengthen.
w6g.ev.chn_strait.con3: Local unrest subsides as cadres tighten administrative cohesion.
w6g.ev.era_inflection.title: A Turning of the Geopolitical Tide
w6g.ev.era_inflection.desc: Decades of shifting alliances, generational turnover in ministries, and contested supply lanes confront governments with an inflection point for the coming era.
w6g.ev.era_inflection.con1: Diplomatic standing and open market confidence rise across capitals.
w6g.ev.era_inflection.con2: Military readiness strengthens while global alignment friction hardens.
w6g.ev.era_inflection.con3: Long-term productivity and internal social peace take priority over blocs.
w6g.ev.syr_frontlines.title: Contested Frontlines Across Syria
w6g.ev.syr_frontlines.desc: Partitioned governorates from Idlib to the Euphrates face competing military commands, exhausted cities, and fragile truces between rival Syrian administrations.
w6g.ev.syr_frontlines.con1: Provincial councils share policing and revenue, easing radicalism at home.
w6g.ev.syr_frontlines.con2: Frontline cohesion sharpens while war fatigue and insurgency risk deepen.
w6g.ev.syr_frontlines.con3: Relief convoys repair devastated districts at heavy treasury expense.
w6g.ev.syr_autonomy.title: Unrest in Jabal al-Arab and the Euphrates
w6g.ev.syr_autonomy.desc: Civic strikes in As-Suwayda and tribal councils along Deir ez-Zor challenge central authority over fuel subsidies, conscription, and local self-defense.
w6g.ev.syr_autonomy.opt1: Grant Municipal Councils and Grain Relief
w6g.ev.syr_autonomy.con1: Local notables de-escalate protests in exchange for fiscal concessions.
w6g.ev.syr_autonomy.con2: Central writ holds checkpoints, though provincial grievances intensify.
w6g.ev.mmr_federal.title: Myanmar's Federal Crossroads
w6g.ev.mmr_federal.desc: Multi-front fighting across Rakhine, Shan, Kachin, Chin, and Karen borderlands leaves armed coalitions and state commands debating whether a new federal compact or attrition will decide the union.
w6g.ev.mmr_federal.opt1: Open a New Federal Union Charter
w6g.ev.mmr_federal.con1: Ethnic administrations enter truce negotiations, calming frontier radicalism.
w6g.ev.mmr_federal.con2: Mobilized columns press the initiative while resistance across the interior grows.
w6g.ev.mmr_federal.con3: Border customs and civilian supply corridors recover first.
w6g.ev.mmr_dryzone.title: Dry Zone Defense Columns Mobilize
w6g.ev.mmr_dryzone.desc: Across Sagaing, Magway, and rural Mandalay, localized defense units tighten control over secondary highways and challenge central tax collection.
w6g.ev.mmr_dryzone.con1: Strongpoint entrenchment rises while popular defiance sharpens.
w6g.ev.mmr_dryzone.con2: Local ceasefires reduce raids and gradually stabilize rural towns.
w6g.ev.cod_kivu.title: Kivu Mineral Corridors in Crisis
w6g.ev.cod_kivu.desc: Fighting between Congo River Alliance columns, local Wazalendo defense groups, and national brigades strains displaced towns and eastern coltan supply routes.
w6g.ev.cod_kivu.con1: External mediators verify disengagement corridors, lowering war damage.
w6g.ev.cod_kivu.con2: Emergency levies and arms procurement surge alongside eastern instability.
w6g.ev.cod_kivu.opt3: Integrate Local Defense Under Provincial Reform
w6g.ev.cod_kivu.con3: Relief spending steadies displaced communities across Kivu and Maniema.
w6g.ev.cod_katanga.title: Katanga and Kasai Fiscal Standoff
w6g.ev.cod_katanga.desc: Southern mining governors in Katanga and civic delegates in Kasai demand transparent constitutional revenue retention as central deficits widen.
w6g.ev.cod_katanga.con1: Southern unrest subsides as provincial assemblies receive dedicated transfers.
w6g.ev.cod_katanga.con2: Immediate treasury receipts recover while autonomist resentment deepens.
